verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents built-in AI features like Composer ("Tell Composer what you're trying to achieve, and it'll build the audience, draft the content, and map out the send strategy") and Customer Agent ("can find the order, check the status, and send an update automatically"), plus AI-powered subject line generation—these are in-product AI assistants a user can delegate tasks to, distinct from the external MCP server. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of these AI features' real-world reliability, and more detail on scope/limits of delegation.
